name: Consensus relation heartbeat review boundary
decision: KRN consensus/eval work should review relation-bearing candidates through heartbeat consensus_evaluation readback that exposes relationReviewFocus, relationReviewQuestion, reviewUsefulness, support/risk evidence refs, candidate reviewability, mutation none, and decision options before any consensus runtime, graph ranking, source truth mutation, or Memory Core mutation is introduced.
consumers: future graph relation duplicate/contradiction review gates
future mini Brain-QA consensus relation cases
falsifier: A future consensus/eval or graph relation candidate still requires raw JSON, implementation code, or historical reports to identify relation focus, review question, support/risk evidence, review usefulness, decision options, or mutation boundaries.
doesNotProve: This retained pattern does not prove source truth, relation correctness, duplicate consolidation safety, consensus correctness, graph ranking quality, autonomous worker execution, Memory Core mutation safety, or KRN product readiness.
